breakpoints.note: The saved crash stack includes `ParseSection_Global` and `Parse_InitExpr`, so the witness passes wasm header/section dispatch and enters the global-initializer walker that exposes the bug.

First project-side materialization point for the vulnerability-relevant state: `Parse_InitExpr()` wraps the attacker-controlled global-initializer bytes in a parser-only `M3Compilation` while leaving `runtime` and `function` NULL.

The staged patch inserts `if (not o->function)` before this dispatch and allows only `i32.const`, `i64.const`, `f32.const`, `f64.const`, `getGlobal`, and `end`; a witness `if` would then hit `default: _throw(m3Err_restictedOpcode)`. The vulnerable source omits that guard and reaches `Compile_If()` instead.
